name: Soetpampoen
summary: Sweet cinnamon pumpkin: chunks of pumpkin cooked in butter, brown sugar and cinnamon until glossy and caramelised at the edges.
about: Sweet pumpkin with cinnamon is a fixture of Afrikaans boerekos. Early Cape cooks paired pumpkin with butter, sugar and cinnamon, and soetpampoen still sits beside the roast, rice and potatoes on Sunday lunch tables.

ingredients.name: Pumpkin
ingredients.note: peeled, seeded and cut into 4 cm chunks; or butternut

steps: Melt the butter in a wide, heavy pot over medium heat. Add the pumpkin, cinnamon sticks, salt and water, cover and simmer for 15–20 minutes, turning gently once, until the pumpkin is just tender when pierced with a knife.

Sprinkle over the sugar, take off the lid and turn the heat to medium-high. Cook for 15–20 minutes, turning the pieces gently now and then without mashing them, until the liquid has become a glossy syrup and the edges are caramelised. Watch it near the end so it does not catch.
Dust with the ground cinnamon and serve hot with a roast or bredie.
prepNote: Cook it a day ahead and reheat in a covered dish at 180 °C for 20 minutes.
